mapper.select: SELECT fault_type, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM fault_report WHERE deleted = 0 AND fault_type IS NOT NULL GROUP BY fault_type ORDER BY cnt DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date_str, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM fault_report WHERE deleted = 0 AND create_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY date_str
